انقضيت (form VII)
# اِنْقَضَيْتُ (inqaḍaytu) /in.qa.dˤaj.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْقَضَى (inqaḍā)
# اِنْقَضَيْتَ (inqaḍayta) /in.qa.dˤaj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْقَضَى (inqaḍā)
# اِنْقَضَيْتِ (inqaḍayti) /in.qa.dˤaj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْقَضَى (inqaḍā)
